conbody.p: The vehicle is composed of a high voltage battery that drives the motor, air conditioner, and charges an auxiliary battery (12 V) that drives all other 12 V systems.
The auxiliary battery is automatically charged when the vehicle is in POWER ON, DRIVE READY mode or the high voltage battery is being charged.

note.p: When decelerating, the regenerative braking system uses the electric motor to recapture kinetic energy and convert it to electrical energy, charging the high voltage battery.
